risk_note: B2-02zb (BR-FUND-19 ⑦; 编排 D10-2219 new task C / D10-2224 / D10-2229 / D10-2237): invariant 07 compared each user entry's balance_after_fen with the previous one, but balance_after_fen comes from the balance cache at posting time; after a cache recalculation (B2-02x) a downward recalculation made the next ordinary credit look like a drop (false difference every day, the check reads the whole history) and an upward one could hide a real deduction. Rule tests first confirmed the false report on main (red/1: old 07 reports the credits after a recalculation). New db/invariants/ledger/11_negative-balance-drops-by-amount.sql: a drop is a voucher whose amount_fen sum on that (account, sub-account) is > 0 with balance_after_fen < 0; only the first entry of the group by (account_version, id) is reported; whitelist types and the :REASSIGN_REV: key exemption apply to that entry; detail shape, output number 07 and checked_rows as in 07; row-for-row identical to 07 on histories without a recalculation (property test). superseded.json appends 07 → 11 in a rule-test commit (approvals 61 / 120 precedent); two frozen kits that named the old file now name 11 (daily-check-execute FILES['07'], admin-union-receipts INVARIANT_FILES; D10-1140 precedent, D10-1670 class, approvals 120). 07 itself and the ledger posting code are unchanged; read-only SQL.

reviews.note: Codex money r1 full review pass (couli-runs/B2-02zb/review-money-r1-codex.json), no S0 / S1; its one S2 (a frozen kit still names the old 07 file, so the integration test would fail) was closed by test attempt 4 (approvals 120): both frozen kits now name 11. The implementation commit 5c8e7edbe is the money-reviewed SQL byte for byte; the superseded.json hunk moved verbatim into the rule-test commit d39e09781. Test machine: rule directory 3 tests, daily-check-execute 33, admin-union-receipts 47 green; verify:fast 0. Implementation probes P1 (extra 'below the previous entry' condition), P2 (exempt by sub_type / voucher_kind), P3 (per-entry amount), P4 (report a drop to exactly 0) each turn the rule tests red (AssertionError).

spec_test_review.note: Rule tests by fresh independent Claude (claude-run.sh, approvals 36), four attempts (the 4th under approvals 120). Codex spec-test r1 (full) fail 7 S1 → test attempt 2; r2 (incremental) fail 1 S1 + 2 S2 → test attempt 3; r3 (incremental, approvals 117 / D10-2229) pass. Red runs red/1–red/3 each exactly #1 #4 #5, AssertionError. r4: a fresh independent Claude read-only review of test attempt 4 (approvals 120) pass, confirming exactly the three named changes (two kit file names and the appended superseded.json entry).
